workflow_read_scope.method: Read every .yml/.yaml file in the exact base commit's .github/workflows directory; inspect Windows/Bazel jobs and shared-action calls. This is a source inspection, not execution or an assertion about future workflow changes.

findings.details: At this exact commit the main Windows Bazel test, shard, Clippy and release-compile jobs use prepare-bazel-ci, which calls setup-bazel-ci. The rust-ci-full argument-comment Bazel job calls setup-bazel-ci directly. The Robrix and isolated research Windows jobs use prepare-bazel-ci. The appended Windows step therefore precedes these current consumers.

The reviewed Windows ARM jobs in rust-ci-full use Cargo lint/nextest paths; the Windows V8 source jobs use the source/GN path. They do not invoke this Windows Bazel setup. build.py remains strictly Windows x64 and would fail closed on an unsupported host; no ARM qualification is claimed.

The helper's product bazel info install_base call does not select ci-windows. The override_repository is scoped to ci-windows (and its ci-windows-cross inclusion), not the general Windows platform section. Therefore this initial install-base lookup does not select the nonexistent override destination. No separate local execution was performed in this review.

The research workflow removes the explicit prepare call now covered by setup. It invokes the same helper only once to prepare; the later invocation is finalize. The helper rejects an already-existing work/destination.

build.py is byte-identical to blob 1439f3fe2e7a342a9fe7a0ae1ab17014552c472f. The strict 20 original-plus-upstream GTest case identities remain required. The original two-case Robrix target and scoped Clippy commands and 30-minute job timeout remain. The candidate .bazelrc changes only the explanatory two-line comment.

Research and Robrix invoke finalize with always() and !cancelled(). A preparation/native/receipt failure cannot become green: finalize requires prepared status, unchanged installed/override inventories, the same product commit, passed complete two-case Robrix receipt, unchanged source inputs and clean tracked checkout. Both retain evidence on a non-cancelled failure.
The new .gitattributes rule fixes top-level helper inputs to LF, including the exact upstream patch. Existing qualification source hashes continue to be checked.

limitations.reviewed_native_success: The parent reported f7's actual 20 GTest + original Robrix2 + Clippy success. This review does not substitute that result for the new shared-entry execution.
limitations.recommended_next: Run the existing isolated research workflow through the shared setup entry and retain its actual result before adopting the shared change more broadly.

conclusion: No confirmed blocking defect found in the reviewed five-file integration proposal. New shared-entry native qualification remains pending.
